name: Switch
description: A toggle switch for binary settings, with role=switch and aria-checked
designIntent: Switch represents an on/off setting that takes effect immediately. Unlike Checkbox, it signals a change of state rather than a form submission value.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fired when the user toggles the switch

examples.title: Settings toggle

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Switch inside forms that need a submit
antiPatterns.explanation: Switch applies immediately. Use Checkbox when the value is submitted with a form.

antiPatterns.title: Don't rely on color alone
antiPatterns.explanation: Switch position conveys state; keep the thumb contrast high in both themes.

accessibility.implementation: role="switch" with aria-checked announces on/off state
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide an accessible name via Label or aria-label

accessibility.implementation: Space and Enter toggle the switch

guidelines: Phrase as the setting, not the action
